ModMetaData.name: Clio Lab (RimWorld)
ModMetaData.author: lumenastrum
ModMetaData.description: Clio's private test bench. Reads JSON commands from an inbox folder (spawn, dress, render, screenshot, ability, log) and writes results next to it, under ClioLab in the RimWorld save-data folder. Meant for an isolated lab instance launched with -savedatafolder, never a real colony. Adds nothing to saves.
